name: Nachos  Casserole
instructions: Add the two packets of taco seasoning to the beef
Fill each packet with water and add to the meat and seasoning mixture
Let meat simmer about 15 minutes covered or until water has evaporated and mixture is not soupy
In casserole dish spread refried beans evenly on bottom of dish , fully covering
Sprinkle 1 cup of shredded cheese over refried beans
Next pour meat mixture over beans and cheese
Cover with remaining cheese and top with green onions
Bake in oven about 15 minutes or until cheese is melted
Serve with tortilla chips and desired toppings
